evidence.statement: The complete all-three exact-16 vocabulary contains no token in the A2451-centered PTC neighborhood.
The exact all-three k=14 computation reproduces the frozen global count of 5,561 but contains zero token overlapping the fixed A2451-centered 51-nt window.
The earlier frozen vocabulary ladder found the k=12 three-domain regime composition/null dominated, so simply lowering k further is not an evidence-clean rescue strategy.

The current exact-word codebook representation therefore captures some ancient reusable ribosomal primitives but does not capture every functionally ancient ribosomal site as an unchanged cross-domain exact string. Functional conservation and literal-string conservation must remain separate layers.

Coder interpretation: a universally important API/function can persist while its literal implementation changes. The next clean decompiler layer should seek constrained variable positions or structural equivalence rather than progressively shortening exact words.

semantics.coder_interpretation: same conserved system function may survive implementation-level sequence divergence

unknowns: Whether a preregistered variable-slot motif recovers the A2451 neighborhood across the same three domains.
Whether a structure-aware vocabulary yields better deep transfer than exact words at this site.
